start.heading: Start a recording project
start.subheading: Point ScrollRecord at a website, mark the blocks to show, and render a smooth scroll video for every device.
start.newProjectHint: From a local site folder or a localhost URL
start.openProjectHint: Continue a project you saved before
start.recentEmpty: No projects yet. They will show up here once you create one.
start.openDialogTitle: Open a project: choose its project.json

recent.trashOpen: Close its tab first to delete this project
recent.trashConfirm: Move “{{name}}” to the Recycle Bin? The website itself is not deleted.

newProject.title: New project
newProject.name: Name
newProject.siteFolderHint: Choose the site's start page (index.html). Its folder becomes the website.
newProject.siteUrlHint: Your running dev server, starting with http:// or https://.
newProject.importHint: If you leave the website empty, the one named in the file is used.

siteMap.title: Site map
siteMap.siteMissing: The site folder wasn't found. It may have been moved or renamed.
siteMap.noBlocks: No blocks found. Mark sections of the site with data-sr="name" to see them here.
siteMap.blockMissing: The scenario uses this block, but it wasn't found on this device. Tried: {{tried}}
siteMap.noLocator: No reliable way to find this element yet (it has no unique name or text in its block).

canvas.title: Scenario canvas
canvas.empty: The scenario is empty. Shapes will be added from the site map (coming in step 3.4).

inspector.title: Properties
inspector.nothingSelected: Nothing selected. Click a shape on the canvas.
inspector.later: Its settings become editable in a later step.

errors.SR-0001: Something unexpected went wrong inside ScrollRecord. This is a bug — please report it and mention {{code}}.
errors.SR-0002: This feature isn't built yet. It's planned for roadmap phase {{phase}}.
errors.SR-0003: The ScrollRecord core isn't reachable. Open this interface inside the desktop app.
errors.SR-0101: Log files couldn't be created. The app still works, but problem reports will contain less detail.
errors.SR-1001: A file couldn't be read. Check the path and that no other program has it locked.
errors.SR-1002: A file couldn't be saved. Check free disk space, and close any player that still has the old video open.
errors.SR-1003: This folder isn't a ScrollRecord project. Choose the folder that contains project.json.
errors.SR-1004: This project was saved by a newer version of ScrollRecord (format {{version}}, this version reads {{supported}}).
errors.SR-1005: This project is already open in another ScrollRecord window, or ScrollRecord closed unexpectedly while it was open.
errors.SR-1006: A folder called “{{name}}” already exists there. Choose another name or location.
errors.SR-1007: The project couldn't be moved to the Recycle Bin, so nothing was deleted. Close programs that use its files and try again.
errors.SR-2001: The scenario file has a mistake on line {{line}}, column {{column}}.
errors.SR-2003: This scenario needs a newer version of ScrollRecord (format {{version}}, this version reads {{supported}}).
errors.SR-2004: There is no render target called “{{target}}”. Available: {{available}}.
errors.SR-2101: The block “{{block}}” wasn't found on the page.
errors.SR-2102: The block “{{block}}” matches several elements. Make its locator more specific or add a data-sr attribute.
errors.SR-3001: No Chrome, Edge or Chromium browser was found. Install one, or choose its location in Settings.
errors.SR-3002: The browser didn't start. Please try again.
errors.SR-3003: Lost contact with the browser while recording.
errors.SR-3005: A helper script inside the page failed.
errors.SR-4001: A video frame couldn't be captured. Try a lower resolution.
errors.SR-5001: ffmpeg wasn't found. It's needed for MP4 and WebM videos; PNG frames work without it.
errors.SR-6002: The cursor pack is broken and can't be used.
errors.SR-8001: No site was chosen. Pick a site folder or a localhost address.
errors.SR-8002: The site folder wasn't found, or it has no index.html.
errors.SR-8003: The built-in local web server couldn't start.
